description:
Sweep follow-up to JMAP-sc1b.53 / JMAP-sc1b.66.

Production clone-subtree sites in client crates not touched by either:
- crate-jmap-base-client/src/request.rs:161 — WebSocketCapability deserialize
- crate-jmap-chat-client/src/session.rs:163 — ChatCapability deserialize
- crate-jmap-chat-client/src/session.rs:181 — ChatPushCapability deserialize
- crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/mod.rs:943 — Value tail decoding

Pattern: serde_json::from_value::<T>(raw.clone()) → T::deserialize(raw) (with 'use serde::Deserialize' if needed).

P4 because these are session/capability extraction sites called once per session bootstrap or chat method dispatch, not in a hot loop. Saving a few small Value clones is correct but not measurable.

jmap-base-client is the canonical foundation client. If reshaping these is desirable, jmap-mail-client and jmap-chat-client should be checked in the same pass (chat-client is already listed above).
title: P4: 4 from_value(v.clone()) sites in *-client production code
